whatThisRecordIs: The current controlling permission state for the Indiana record-clearing form bundles, attachments and official participant-facing instruments assigned by the current RCAP legal design, recorded from the project owner's attestation.

priorState.meaning: Indiana was genuinely blocked: generationAllowed false, reproduction fail-closed. This attestation is what unblocks it.

whatIsNotAsserted: any term the project owner did not provide
provenance.whyNotAsserted: None of it was supplied. An attestation is not a document and must not be dressed as one.

granted: reproduce completed participant-controlled portions of forms
supply completed or partially completed forms to participants
use the forms in LegalEase's paid document-preparation service
use source copies for implementation, testing and verification
render the forms as part of an assembled participant packet

familyScope.family: the Indiana record-clearing form bundles, attachments and official participant-facing instruments assigned by the current RCAP legal design
familyScope.scopeNote: Recorded at family level, as the attestation was given. Applying it to the family means a revision update within the same issuing authority and form family does not reopen the permission question.
covers: forms attributed to Indiana Legal Help, Inc.
forms attributed to the Coalition for Court Access
the current Indiana record-clearing packet bundles
the current conviction, collateral-action and supplemental-order form families used by RCAP
familyScope.outsideTheFamily: A genuinely new publisher or an unrelated form family stays outside this attestation unless the live authorization model identifies it as part of the same covered RCAP family.

retiredBlockers.note: These no longer apply to covered identities. They are retired because the question they asked is answered, not because they were wrong.

notGranted: altering form titles or revision marks
claiming endorsement by the issuing authority
applying this state's permission to another state's forms
boundaries.prefillLimit: Only participant-controlled and deterministic fields permitted by the existing field classification may be prefilled.
boundaries.thirdPartyFieldRuleUnchanged: Judge, clerk, prosecutor, agency, notary and process-server fields stay blank unless the governing form expressly assigns the field to the participant.

historicalRecordsPreserved.note: Their permission-required conclusions were accurate before this attestation reached the factory. A later grant does not make an accurate record inaccurate, and the workers are not represented as mistaken.

receiptTreatment.note: Authorization is a permission fact and materialization is an evidence fact. No receipt is touched because the licence answer moved.

editionTreatment.note: Edition 1.3 is published and immutable. An external authorization fact does not rewrite it; if the canonical model needs an edition consequence it is recorded as a successor handoff.

supersedes.note: The prior record was accurate: no permission had been supplied to the factory and the rights holder was unconfirmed. A successor records that the answer changed; it does not make the old record wrong.

rightsHolderQuestionClosed.wasOpen: which named organization holds the rights — Indiana Legal Help, Inc. or the Coalition for Court Access
rightsHolderQuestionClosed.nowClosed: The project owner attests that LegalEase possesses the rights necessary from the relevant rights holders. No further determination of which organization holds them is required before reproducing or prefilling the covered forms.
rightsHolderQuestionClosed.attributionsPreserved: Both attributions stay recorded on their documents as provenance. Closing the permission question does not erase who published what.

accessControlsNotWaived.statement: Permission is not authority to bypass a technical protection. CAPTCHA, Cloudflare, Akamai, authentication, credentials and cookie or token protections are not to be evaded.

currentnessNotEstablished: Permission does not make a retained revision current. Currentness, supersession, source bytes, bundle page identity, document role, field mapping, source receipt and participant-versus-court field classification all remain open on their own terms.
doNotDuplicateBundles: Several identities resolving to different pages inside one retained bundle is not a reason to duplicate the bundle.
